enrichment method: SDS page band excision; biotin-phalloidin pulldown; DNaseI agarose pulldown

we fractionated total cell lysates on SDS page and broadly excised a prominent protein band in the ∼43 kDa range corresponding to the actin’s molecular weight; we performed pulldowns of mouse brain and retina extracts using biotin-phalloidin (that interacts with F-actin) or DNaseI agarose beads (that binds to G-actin)
fractionation method: we fractionated total cell lysates on SDS page
instrument: The trypsin digested actin was analyzed using a standard 90-min LC gradient on the Thermo Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer.
labeling: Intensities of each peptide species were added together and divided by the total intensity added for the entire repertoire of the N-termini for each actin isoform to obtain fractions of the total shown in the figures.
ptm: static carboxamidomethylation of Cys; variable Met oxidation; variable protein N-terminal acetylation; variable Asn deamidation; variable arginylation on any D and E; variable monomethylarginylation on any D and E; variable dimethylarginylation on any D and E

using static carboxamidomethylation of Cys, and variable Met oxidation, protein N-terminal acetylation, and Asn deamidation... including arginylation, monomethylarginylation, and dimethylarginylation on any D and E as a variable modification
